title: SGM Capability Discovery
description: The object returned during capability discovery. Normative structure for spec/capabilities.md.

protocol_version.description: The SGM specification version this implementation conforms to.

implementation_version.description: Version of the implementation. Never part of protocol identity.

capabilities.description: Capability profiles supported. 'core' is always present.

transports.description: Transport bindings offered, if the transport capability is advertised.

limits.description: Implementation limits a consumer should respect.
